sahneler.metin: Workers mixed uranium by hand, using stainless steel buckets.
Suddenly the tank went critical, starting a nuclear chain reaction.
It happened at a fuel processing plant in Tokaimura, Japan.
They were following an unapproved shortcut procedure.
Far too much uranium went into one precipitation tank.
The workers were exposed to intense radiation.
There was no alarm: regulators believed criticality couldn't happen there.
